title: Agent registry: which agents does your tenant have, and who can stop them?
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview automation for User access, which the page reports as undocumented. The draft-agent limitation is also reversed: Copilot Studio is the only platform whose drafts are visible, not a platform where only drafts are visible. The listed admin paths and package endpoints are supported.

claims.claim: The agent registry is the tenant agent inventory in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: The agent registry in Microsoft 365 admin center provides a centralized view of all agents available for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators can see agent owners in the registry.
claims.quote: For each agent, you can see who owns it, how much people use it, and whether it has any risks.

claims.claim: The registry shows agent risk signals.
claims.quote: Risk signals in the Agent Registry are a consolidated set of agent-related security detections that give IT administrators a single view of agent risks across their tenant.

claims.claim: Administrators can block agents through the registry.
claims.quote: The Microsoft 365 admin center provides governance and lifecycle management capabilities for agents through the Agent Registry. ... Block and unblock

claims.claim: Administrators can install agents through the registry.
claims.quote: In the All agents page, make sure Registry is selected. ... From the list of agents, select an agent that isn't already installed. ... select Install.

claims.claim: Administrators can delete agents through the registry.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... On the All agents page, select the agent that you want to delete. ... In the agent details pane, select Delete agent.

claims.claim: Administrators can reassign agents through the registry.
claims.quote: IT administrators can reassign ownership for agents that don't have an owner or that are active.

claims.claim: The registry is part of Microsoft Agent 365.
claims.quote: A key capability within Microsoft Agent 365 is the agent registry, which provides a unified inventory of all agents operating in the organization, including both Microsoft and non-Microsoft agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Agent 365 as an observability platform giving one view of agents from Microsoft and other companies.
claims.quote: Microsoft Agent 365 is the observability platform for AI. It gives you one view of the agents in your organization, including agents from Microsoft and from other companies.

claims.claim: The registry lists agents from Microsoft, partners and the organisation's own teams.
claims.quote: It includes agents from Microsoft, from partners, and from your own teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft agents are built and maintained by Microsoft.
claims.quote: Microsoft agents | Agents built and maintained by Microsoft.

claims.claim: External partner-built agents are built by trusted non-Microsoft developers and published for broader or public availability.
claims.quote: External partner-built agents | Agents built by trusted non-Microsoft developers and published for broader or public availability.

claims.claim: Published by your org agents are custom agents approved and published by the organisation, also called line-of-business agents.
claims.quote: Published by your org | Custom agents approved and published by your organization for broader use. These agents might be referred to as LOB (Line of Business) agents.

claims.claim: Shared by creator agents are created and shared by individual users or developers, also called shared agents.
claims.quote: Shared by creator | Agents created and shared by individual users or developers at your organization. These agents are commonly referred to as Shared agents.
